data.revised_prompt:
Edit the provided SCI journal figure while preserving the overall canvas, three-column layout, labels, borders, title tabs (Glare / Specular / Dark), bottom dashed boxes, and the semi-photorealistic wall/drone/floor style. Keep the improved degraded sensor-observation panels and do not add any new explanatory text.

Critical edits:
1) Top plan-view map: correct it to match env_cuda.py. Make the front wall a vertical wall at fixed x=0.65 in top view, not horizontal bars. Represent the physical front wall as exactly two separated vertical wall blocks along y, aligned at x=0.65, with a narrow central slit/gap between them. Do not draw a rectangular tunnel, doorway frame, or four small horizontal bars. Add the back wall as a single solid vertical slab farther right around x=2.55. Keep the dashed slot lines far_left, left, right, far_right as secondary lateral guides behind the front wall. Keep Start at x=-1.0 on the left and Goal at x=1.8 on the right.
2) Middle-row trajectory arrows: in all three third-person scene panels, make the blue dashed flight arrows point only from the drone upward into the slit/wall opening. Remove any downward arrowhead or bidirectional arrow; all arrowheads should point toward the wall/slit. Slightly orient the drone/camera so it visually faces the wall/slit.

Preserve existing visual effects:
- Glare panel: keep orange light at the slit and readable walls.
- Specular panel: keep cyan/white reflective side-wall patches.
- Dark panel: keep dark side-wall patches.
- Bottom Glare: washed-out white speckles and uncertain slit edges.
- Bottom Specular: cyan glints, noisy false-depth speckles, curved cyan arrows, unstable slit boundaries.
- Bottom Dark: black/noisy weak-return bands with sparse speckles.

Avoid making labels unreadable or changing the layout. Keep the top map physically consistent with fixed-x front/back walls.
